_about: Curated named bridges for cargo tools osm-bridges: the border, Canadian, Alaska and hand-picked US bridges a 2.0 leg crosses, written whatever their length. name is the spoken name; osm lists the bridge's own road ways (or a type=bridge relation, or a man_made=bridge outline); legs are the legs expected to cross it, either direction. OpenStreetMap ways read from the 2026-11-16 planet.
